protocol.name: GAL-02 STACK to F.A.S.T. handoff
protocol.description: Moves a plate STACK to F.A.S.T. and back in three steps (STACK transfer in, F.A.S.T. transfer, STACK transfer out), minting one step key per STACK leg for every run; defaults are the PAC simulator lab names and hardware names are entered by the operator in Phase 7 (see docs/runbooks/gal-02-handoff.md).

parameters.name: batch_label
parameters.label: Batch label
parameters.description: Run label at the start of both STACK step keys; only its first 20 characters are used.

parameters.name: stack_tool
parameters.label: STACK tool instance
parameters.description: Name of the STACK tool instance in the workcell (exact case).

parameters.name: fast_tool
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. tool instance
parameters.description: Name of the F.A.S.T. tool instance in the workcell (exact case).

parameters.name: robot
parameters.label: STACK robot
parameters.description: STACK robot name used for both transfers.

parameters.name: labware_profile
parameters.label: Labware profile
parameters.description: STACK labware profile used for both transfers.

parameters.name: source_device
parameters.label: Source device
parameters.description: Where the plate starts and returns: STACK device.

parameters.name: source_deck
parameters.label: Source deck
parameters.description: Where the plate starts and returns: STACK deck.

parameters.name: source_nest
parameters.label: Source nest
parameters.description: Where the plate starts and returns: STACK nest.

parameters.name: source_transfer_profile
parameters.label: Source transfer profile
parameters.description: Optional STACK transfer profile for the source location; blank sends none.

parameters.name: fast_device
parameters.label: F.A.S.T.-side device
parameters.description: STACK device that stands for the F.A.S.T. deck position.

parameters.name: fast_deck
parameters.label: F.A.S.T.-side deck
parameters.description: STACK deck that stands for the F.A.S.T. deck position.

parameters.name: fast_nest
parameters.label: F.A.S.T.-side nest
parameters.description: STACK nest that stands for the F.A.S.T. deck position.

parameters.name: fast_transfer_profile
parameters.label: F.A.S.T.-side transfer profile
parameters.description: Optional STACK transfer profile for the F.A.S.T.-side location; blank sends none.

parameters.name: stack_timeout_s
parameters.label: STACK timeout (s)
parameters.description: Optional wait budget in seconds for each STACK transfer; blank uses the adapter default.

parameters.name: fast_step_source_deck
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. source deck
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer source_deck (deck slot number).

parameters.name: fast_step_dest_deck
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. destination deck
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer dest_deck (deck slot number).

parameters.name: fast_step_source_plate_id
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. source plate id
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer source_plate_id.

parameters.name: fast_step_dest_plate_id
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. destination plate id
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer dest_plate_id.

parameters.name: fast_step_source_start_row
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. source start row
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer source_start_row (one or two letters).

parameters.name: fast_step_source_start_col
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. source start column
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer source_start_col.

parameters.name: fast_step_dest_start_row
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. destination start row
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer dest_start_row (one or two letters).

parameters.name: fast_step_dest_start_col
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. destination start column
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer dest_start_col.

parameters.name: fast_step_num_rows
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. rows
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer num_rows.

parameters.name: fast_step_num_cols
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. columns
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer num_cols.

parameters.name: fast_step_volume
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. volume (uL)
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer volume in microlitres; must be above 0.

parameters.name: fast_step_tip_reuse
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. tip reuse
parameters.description: F.A.S.T. transfer tip_reuse mode.

parameters.name: fast_step_expected_tray_id
parameters.label: F.A.S.T. expected tray id
parameters.description: Optional F.A.S.T. transfer expected_tray_id; blank sends none.
